hermes.goal: Beat buy-and-hold (positive alpha vs BTC) while keeping max drawdown under 15% and never risking the mandate on a single trade — capital preservation first. Near-term: prove a sustained, fee-aware, positive out-of-sample edge on the paper trainer over ~90 days before scaling any live capital; grow the live account only on demonstrated alpha.

brain.commentary: Broad cross-asset stress warrants capital-preservation sizing and limits conviction in all crypto longs. BTC is the strongest and most liquid signal but remains exposed to the stressed regime. ETH and SOL carry higher beta, volatility, and downside expected shortfall, making their long signals fragile. BCH, DOGE, and LTC have negative composites and weak institutional/liquidity support; retain a defensive bias. ETC/USD is especially fragile and should be effectively sidelined because its zero price, zero volatility, and zero liquidity indicate invalid or missing market data.
